notes: SSL foundation model for wrist-worn accelerometry. Pretrained on UK-Biobank accelerometer data (>700,000 person-days, ~100k subjects) via multi-task self-supervision (arrow-of-time, permutation, time-warping pretext tasks). Backbone is a ResNet-V2-style 1D CNN feature extractor. Input: tri-axial accelerometer resampled to 30Hz; standard window 10s = 300 samples. Released weights loadable via torch.hub: torch.hub.load('OxWearables/ssl-wearables','harnet5'/'harnet10'/'harnet30', class_num=N, pretrained=True) where 5/10/30 = window length in seconds at 30Hz. Feature extractor is pretrained; classifier head is untrained and requires fine-tuning. Evaluated on seven downstream HAR benchmarks (F1 relative improvement 2.5%-100%, median 18.4%). ACTIVE HALO baseline: released pretrained weights available. arXiv PDF (18pp (~8pp main body)) downloaded is the condensed preprint; the full peer-reviewed version is the npj Digital Medicine article. Additional pretrained variants (Capture-24, Rowlands, 1k-subject subsets) hosted on project server.
